'''Geoff Snider LS''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Geoff Snider]] posted on DeckTech. The published title is not used as the page title; it appears in the original post below.<ref name="dt-10572">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/10572 DeckTech post 10572], DeckTech (Geoff "gsiva" Snider, 21 September 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/10572/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/10572/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018114742/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/10572/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Original post ==

'''f u c k i n g cloud city'''
* '''Author:''' Geoff "gsiva" Snider
* '''Published:''' September 21, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' capiowh

=== Strategy ===

strategy is cool...so you sit at the upper 1/0 site and throw down some monkeys...then you spread out in one turn once you get all your guys out and then drain the sh1t out of them...they'll never expect it.

claws are for decree/battle order signal first for insurrection initiate 5 battles/turn and you'll come out on top after they spread out to stop your super drain INDOORS  heh

hooptie
